title: NFL Football
description:
Arizona Cardinals at Kansas City Chiefs
The Kansas City Chiefs host the Arizona Cardinals in NFL regular-season play at Arrowhead Stadium. The Kansas City Chiefs enter at 7-2 after a 35-13 road win over the Atlanta Falcons, while the Arizona Cardinals arrive 3-7 and losers of two straight.

title: NFL Football
description:
Jacksonville Jaguars at New York Giants
The New York Giants host the Jacksonville Jaguars in NFL play at MetLife Stadium. At 7-2, Jacksonville has won three straight and enters as one of the AFC's top teams, while New York sits at 5-3-1 after dropping its last game to Washington.
